## Eight primitives

`byte`, `short`, `int`, `long`, `float`, `double`, `char`, `boolean`. They hold values directly (not references) and have fixed sizes.

## Wrappers

Each primitive has an object wrapper (`Integer`, `Long`, `Boolean`...). Autoboxing converts between them, but beware `NullPointerException` when unboxing a `null` wrapper.

## Local type inference

`var` (Java 10+) infers the type from the initializer for **local variables** only. It is still statically typed — not dynamic.
